articles.headline: Jaylen Brown banged up but combines with Joel Embiid to lead 76ers past Nets
articles.description: Joel Embiid (37 points) and Jaylen Brown (31) both turned in season highs Monday night as the 76ers beat the Nets with LeBron James sidelined to improve to 12-3.

images.name: Jaylen Brown #7, Tyrese Maxey #0, and Joel Embiid [600x400]
images.credit: Nathaniel S. Butler/NBAE via Getty Images

images.name: Jaylen Brown  [600x400]
images.caption: Jaylen Brown left in the fourth quarter after bumping heads with Brooklyn's Julius Randle. He eventually returned to the court with a bandage on his forehead, before putting on a headband and doing a ninja move to the amusement of the 76ers bench.

articles.headline: Devin Booker scores 20 points, Suns beat Nuggets 117-105 for their 1st road win of the season
articles.description: — Devin Booker led seven Phoenix players in doubles figures with 20 points and the Suns beat the Denver Nuggets 117-105 on Monday night for their first road win of the season.

articles.headline: Terrence Shannon Jr. scores career-high 34 points as Timberwolves beat Trail Blazers 106-98
articles.description: — Terrence Shannon Jr. scored 12 of his career-high 34 points in the second quarter as the Minnesota Timberwolves recovered from a slow start to beat the Portland Trail Blazers 106-98 on Monday night in the opener of a two-game set.

articles.headline: Fears' first triple-double leads the Pelicans past the Warriors 115-94
articles.description: — Jeremiah Fears had 19 points, 10 assists and 10 rebounds for his first career triple-double, and the New Orleans Pelicans snapped a six-game losing streak with a 115-94 victory over the Golden State Warriors on Monday night.

articles.headline: Embiid has season-high 37 and Brown adds 31 as 76ers beat Nets 135-123 without LeBron James
articles.description: — Joel Embiid scored a season-high 37 points, Jaylen Brown matched his season best with 31 and the superstars provided the Philadelphia 76ers with more than enough in LeBron James' absence to beat the Brooklyn Nets 135-123 on Monday night.

articles.headline: Giannis Antetokounmpo scores 20, Heat roll past Rockets 128-110 for 5th straight win
articles.description: — Giannis Antetokounmpo scored 20 points and grabbed 13 rebounds, Andrew Wiggins and Klay Thompson each scored 17 and the Miami Heat never trailed on the way to beating the Houston Rockets 128-110 on Monday night for their fifth straight victory.

articles.headline: Bane scores 24, Magic rally in 4th quarter to beat Celtics 115-105, extend win streak to 4 games
articles.description: — Desmond Bane had 24 points and eight rebounds to help the Orlando Magic rally in the fourth quarter and earn their fourth consecutive victory, 115-105 over the Boston Celtics on Monday night.

articles.headline: Mitchell and Allen power the Cavaliers to a 126-115 win over the Bulls
articles.description: — Donovan Mitchell scored 39 points and Jarrett Allen added 13 points and 14 rebounds as the Cleveland Cavaliers overcame an early deficit and beat the Chicago Bulls 126-115 on Monday night.
